name: Rolling counter
description: Give changing quantities a sense of direction.
detail: Digits move in the direction of the value change. Useful for quantities, totals, and compact numerical adjustments.
when: Adjustable integer quantities, totals, or compact counters.
integration: Connect value/onValueChange and the allowed range. The reference supports 0–999; adapt digit count explicitly for larger ranges or signed values.
props: value, defaultValue, onValueChange, min, max, label, speed, radius, className, style
